routes.description: SIGNATURE — The fjord run: historic quay to Brazil's only tropical fjord. Daily shared-lancha tours operate this today (R$130–300 pp). Haversine 5.2 nm + ~2.3 nm coastal wrap: the sea path exits the Baía de Paraty and rounds the Paraty Mirim headlands into the fjord mouth before running south between its walls.

SIGNATURE — The UNESCO twin-site crossing: Paraty's colonial quay to car-free Vila do Abraão. Real transfer corridor today (shared boat from R$330 pp, private lancha from R$1,890, ~1.5 h). Haversine 30.4 nm + ~0.6 nm margin threading the bay's island field. Cross-market route; the Angra market holds the Abraão-side node (rn- route family).

Bay spur on the classic schooner/lancha circuit (Ilha do Algodão, Praia da Lula waters) to the Paraty Mirim beach ramp. Haversine 4.4 nm + ~0.6 nm wrap around the Ponta do Cabo island field at the bay mouth.

The caiçara taxi-boat corridor: Laranjeiras to road-free Ponta Negra village past Praia do Sono and Antigos (today R$40–60/leg to Sono, ~R$120 RT Ponta Negra, open wooden boats on exposed water). Haversine 3.3 nm + ~0.7 nm wrap around the Sono/Antigos headlands on the open-Atlantic coast.
Marina spur across the inner bay: historic quay to Marina do Engenho — charter staging and charging shuttle. Direct water path; haversine distance.

Coastal flight to Trindade's beach landing — today only a 40-min mountain road; no scheduled sea link. Haversine 8.0 nm + ~3 nm coastal wrap: the sea path leaves the bay south and rounds the exposed headlands (Cajaíba/Juruoca coast) before Trindade's cove.

Gateway link: Paraty quay to the Laranjeiras pier, the boarding point for Praia do Sono/Ponta Negra. Haversine 7.5 nm + ~3.5 nm wrap — the direct line crosses the Juatinga hills, so the sea path rounds the southern headlands of the bay.
Premium charter spur: Porto Imperial marina direct to the Mamanguá fjord. Haversine 4.9 nm + ~2.1 nm coastal wrap around the Paraty Mirim headlands into the fjord.

routes.description: Costa Verde heritage corridor: Paraty to Angra dos Reis along the mainland shore of the Baía da Ilha Grande. Haversine 25.2 nm + ~2.8 nm coastal wrap; kept at ~28 nm for consistency with the Angra market brief (Angra ↔ Paraty ~28 nm). No scheduled service today — the corridor is driven by road.

Inter-market line-haul: Paraty to Ilhabela's Pier da Vila. Haversine 48.9 nm + ~3 nm wrap around the Ponta da Juatinga; held at 52 nm to match the existing Ilhabela inventory entry (ssb-ilb-pier-da-vila ↔ paraty-waterfront, 52 nm aspirational). Within the 70 nm electric envelope but a long open-coast leg — note near-range planning margin.
